intended_use: Decision support for research and teaching: breast density category from a single mammogram view. Density is not a cancer diagnosis and this model does not detect cancer.
training_data: MONAI Model Zoo breast density classification model. The training data and labels are documented by the upstream project; MIAP does not retrain or extend them.
validation: No clinical validation on Ugandan or local patients. The local CPU gate (2026-11-10) passed: mean 0.109 s per view, 2.65 s first result including a 299x299 Grad-CAM, 465 MB peak RSS, recorded in ml/benchmark/monai_density_benchmark.json. That gate tests speed and CAM sanity, not accuracy.
limitations: Breast density is not the same as cancer risk; clinical judgement and local guidelines decide follow-up.
The model runs per view; the exam summary reports the highest density per breast with a caveat.
Not validated on implants, prior breast surgery, males or poorly positioned views.
Scores are uncalibrated and the heatmap shows where the model looked, not proof of disease.
Women with dense breasts can still have cancer that this model does not detect.
intended_population: Adults undergoing screening or diagnostic mammography in the four standard views (CC/MLO, left/right).
input: One mammogram view resized to 299x299 (not centre-cropped, to keep the breast), three channels, [0,1] range.
output: Density category probabilities and a Grad-CAM from Mixed_7c.
ethical_notes: Do not use as a stand-alone triage tool. Discuss density results in the local breast pathway.
